rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; f1099div p. 5, Instructions for Recipient: "Box 2b. Shows the portion of the amount in box 2a that is unrecaptured section 1250 gain". As the earlier ruling of this line: the project asks box 2b only when box 2a (sd.distributions) is above zero and a Form 1099-DIV shows an amount in the less common boxes (div.capital_gain_boxes); the reply drops the box 2a parent and reads div.box2b where it is not asked. With box 2a zero, box 2b, a portion of it, is zero, so the values agree. Rerun only because the less-common-boxes question no longer lists boxes 2e and 2f (BUG-1130).

Ruling: representation; f1099div p. 5, Instructions for Recipient: "Box 2d. Shows the portion of the amount in box 2a that is 28% rate gain". As box 2b and the earlier ruling of this line: the project asks box 2d only when box 2a is above zero (div.capital_gain_boxes); the reply drops that parent. With box 2a zero, box 2d is zero; the values agree. Rerun only because the less-common-boxes question no longer lists boxes 2e and 2f (BUG-1130).

Ruling: representation; the candidate's all[div.any = true, box 1a > 0] is the project's test written out: the project's operand sb.ordinary_dividends_if_dividends is box 1a when div.any is yes and zero when it is no, so both are true exactly when dividends were received and box 1a is above zero. Ruled by reading: the scoped reply names interfaces the candidate bank does not resolve, as in the earlier line-scoped passes of this lane.

Ruling: interface gap; f1099div (2025) Instructions for Recipient describes the dividend boxes, but defines no quantity named div.screen. The reply explicitly invents a total of special amounts because the required export has no supplied semantic contract. The project uses this internal adapter as zero after scope checks, including when unsupported Form4797/K-1 amounts are absent; that behavior was not independently inferable from the id/type alone. No whole-tree equivalence or clean model-only error is claimed. BUG-0135/T-064 keeps this source-interface review pending until adapter and source-defined quantities are separated.
